question: Should selected Discord role IDs be allowed to wake every eligible agent receiving that role mention, and should this policy be configurable at both guild and channel scope?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but multi-agent fan-out changes intentional trigger policy, operating cost, and loop exposure while adding a compatibility-sensitive configuration surface.

options.title: Add opt-in role triggers
options.body: Introduce a distinct guild/channel role-ID allowlist for wake targeting while retaining direct bot mentions as the default behavior.

options.title: Support managed bot roles only
options.body: Treat only each bot's Discord-managed role as equivalent to its direct user mention, addressing autocomplete ambiguity without general role fan-out.

options.title: Keep direct mentions only
options.body: Decline role-based wake fan-out and continue requiring direct bot mentions, replies, or configured textual mention patterns.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in role triggers
recommendation.body: Introduce a distinct guild/channel role-ID allowlist for wake targeting while retaining direct bot mentions as the default behavior.
